verdict.rationale: PayPal Agentic Commerce is a SaaS platform that processes merchant catalogs and buyer transaction data for AI agents, so a buyer could fairly ask whether that data can be excluded from AI model training. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a training opt-out, a no-training commitment, or any data-usage controls for AI training. The pack covers only integrations, catalogs, cart APIs, tooling, webhooks and fees.
